title: Crispy Thai Almond Cookies with Jamaican Jam Filling
description: A sweet and crunchy Thai-inspired cookie with a tangy Jamaican jam filling. Perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together fermented rice flour, ground almonds, salt, and sugar.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs and jamaican jam.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut into desired shapes using a cookie cutter.
Place on prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Allow to cool completely on a wire rack before filling with jamaican jam.
